claim: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop app where humans and agents architect software together in a common workspace.

note: the SDK is the MCP/JSON tool API generated from the host's zod schemas
claim: Whiteboard plugs into tools you already use (Claude Code, Codex) and gives the agent an SDK to draw on an in-app canvas to describe its work.

note: trace quotes are checked against the retained event and the authoring prompt asks for literal user quotes, but only when trace capture is enabled (opt-in)
claim: A decision log lets agents query and link their own traces so the reader sees the requirements set, how they were implemented and which decisions the agent made autonomously.
